title: What Dream Cinema Systems Is
definition: Dream Cinema Systems: films experienced inside lucid dreams.
description:

title: The Signature Vision: Dream Cinema Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Dream Cinema Systems.

The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Dream Cinema Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Dream Cinema Systems
definition: Estimates Dream Cinema Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Dream Cinema Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cinema hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Dream Cinema Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Dream Cinema Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Dream Cinema Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 16556 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where dream induction monitoring, cinema logistics redundancy, or narrative design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Dream Cinema Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Dream Cinema Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Dream Cinema Systems — films experienced inside lucid dreams.

Phase 1 — Prove (dream induction): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cinema logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (narrative design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (sleep safety): cinema hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and audiences-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
